description: This file defines an interface IInvokable which represents an asynchronously invokable object, likely used in remote procedure call scenarios within Orleans framework. It includes method signatures for invocation, argument handling, target management, and cancellation.

methods.name: GetTarget
methods.description: Returns the invocation target object, nullable.

methods.name: SetTarget
methods.description: Sets the invocation target from an ITargetHolder instance.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes the object asynchronously and returns a ValueTask<Response>.

methods.name: GetArgument
methods.description: Retrieves the argument at a specified index.

methods.name: SetArgument
methods.description: Sets the argument at a specified index.

methods.name: GetMethodName
methods.description: Returns the name of the method to invoke.

methods.name: GetActivityName
methods.description: Returns a string combining interface and method name, indicating activity.

methods.name: GetMethod
methods.description: Returns the MethodInfo object representing the method, or null.

methods.name: GetInterfaceType
methods.description: Returns the Type object of the interface.

methods.name: GetDefaultResponseTimeout
methods.description: Provides the default timeout duration for responses, or null if none.

methods.name: GetCancellationToken
methods.description: Retrieves the CancellationToken associated with the invocation.

methods.name: TryCancel
methods.description: Attempts to cancel the invocation; returns true if successful, false otherwise.
